claim: Tesla's Q3 2025 sales grew 12% from the same quarter a year earlier.
summary: Based on internal knowledge as of cutoff, Tesla reported Q3 2025 total revenue ~$28.1B vs ~$25.2B in Q3 2024, a ~11.6% YoY increase widely reported as ~12%, making the 12% growth claim approximately correct for dollar sales.

sub_claims.stated_text: Tesla's Q3 2025 sales grew 12% from the same quarter a year earlier.
